purpose: English surface candidates for contextual review. Counts and fixed low priority are not semantic severity, authorship evidence, or edit instructions. Semantic judgment follows references/semantic-families.md and en-wording.md.

source_basis.black: Archived Black writing tutorial, L226-241: wording and navigation candidates; academic grammar belongs to academic-writing.
source_basis.ptd: B1/sources/paper-thesis-discipline-2026-09-22.md L24-49; adopted with the scopes in B1/legacy-rule-triage.md PTD-06,08,10,12-18.
source_basis.muse: MUSE YXC-10/14/31 and B1/accepted-repairs.md: punctuation signals require local reading; whole-entry rewrites do not isolate punctuation effects.
source_basis.authority: academic-writing Authority owns D3/D6/D7/D8; lint locates wording without resolving positioning, claims, or limitations.
source_basis.humanizer: Community lexicon blader/humanizer v3.1.0 (repos/reference/AIGC-prevent/humanizer/SKILL.md) §1/§5/§12/§13/§18: phrase lists adopted as locators only; its examples are not reproduced.
source_basis.hc3: HC3 indicating_words_en_chatgpt.txt: list-announcement openers from QA data; assistant register, not article prose evidence.

lexical_trace.description: Frequently reported wording; inspect its local object and function.

rules.message: 核对是否表达具体动作或性质；词语本身不构成错误，保留准确的技术用法和作者力度。

semantic_restatement.description: Possible repeated benefit statements; the preceding and following sentences decide redundancy.

rules.message: 复读分词尾句及上下文；只在其重复已知评价且没有结果含义或承接作用时精简。
检查是否新增能力、推论或后文所需承接；确认无阅读增量后才删，不预设方法之后不能解释好处。

meta_performance.description: Transition and navigation wording; retain its actual explanatory or navigational function.

rules.message: 检查后文是否直接交代具体难点及其关系；依据已有材料修订空宣告，保留有效让步。
此处只检测句末裸宣告；连同随后内容检查是否已解释具体挑战及解法。具体命名、公式或清单引出的挑战不由此规则命中。
检查是否代替了具体需求，或确实承接已说明的原因；没有材料时不补造难点。
按体裁和阅读依赖判断导航作用；复杂推导的目标与去向可保留，不按句式自动删除。
检查贡献起句与内容层级；此模式只定位起句，不禁止定义、公式或列表中的冒号，也不限定贡献条数。

abstract_evaluation.description: Generic assessments and causal templates whose referents require reading.

rules.message: 问：相对什么？技术定义（robust statistics、gated units）、有对照的 novel、有检验的 significant 保留；没有标准的评价词换成它所指的属性或数字，删后不得留下更泛的命题。
核对归因是否来自作者材料；不能换成This likely stems from后继续猜因。学术结果解释缺材料时按academic-writing作者规则交接。
意义拔高：保留事实，删去对意义的宣告；段落以最后一个具体事实结束。

positioning_language.description: Surface contrast spans. Only contextual review under academic-writing Authority can determine whether D3 applies.

rules.message: 先识别比较双方和段落职责。本文相对既有工作的定位交作者决定；背景中并列他人发现、方法定义所需对照可保留。此命中不授权自动改写、删除或降级结论。

contrastive_scaffold.description: Negated foil before the claim; keep when the negative half corrects a belief the reader actually holds or both halves carry information.

rules.message: 问：被否定的一半有人持有吗？删掉它后半句是否受损？不受损就直接陈述；不倒装成 rather than 充数，不改变作者确定度。

strawman_opening.description: An opponent nobody in the text holds, or a denial of an objection nobody raised.

rules.message: 问：这个对手是谁？有归属的反对意见和读者真会权衡的选项保留并写全；找不到对手就删去引子，直接写判断。
核对文中是否真有人提出这个反对；没有就删去，保留随后的事实。连续几条无关的否认比一条更可疑。

stiff_register.description: Verbs that detour around is/has, list-announcement openers and nominalised frames; single uses are ordinary.

rules.message: 成片绕开 is / has / use / help 时按段落恢复直接动词；单独出现不是问题，专名与引文不动。
问答助手式开场进入正文即铺垫：删去后直接写第一条内容。

hollow_coordination.description: Headings and abstract pairs that list items without stating the relation; two topics with their own content, fixed phrases and navigation headings keep.

rules.message: 标题只摆项目还是说出了判断？正文已建立关系或结论的写出来；并列项即内容、固定节名、导航标题保留。
任何对象都有的抽象两面：补上本处对象，或写出本处真正比较的东西。

derived_signals.interpretation: Counts only rank passages for rereading; no numerical threshold or semantic severity follows from the distribution.
